title: Brazilian Chicken Pasta
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make pasta dish featuring chicken, tomatoes, and a hint of Brazilian spices.

ingredients.name: nutty oil
ingredients.notes: such as peanut or Brazil nut oil

ingredients.name: Brazilian spices
ingredients.notes: such as cumin, oregano, and thyme

instructions: Cook pasta according to package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat the nutty oil over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-6 minutes.
Transfer the chicken to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm.
In the same skillet, add the diced juicy tomatoes and cook until they start to break down, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the Brazilian spices and stir to combine.
Return the chicken to the skillet and toss with the tomato mixture.
Stir in the chopped cilantro, if using.
Serve the chicken and tomato mixture over the cooked pasta.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
